title: Smooth Scaler batcher and quantization onramp for budgeted burst control
author: Aisha Romero
description: Problem: sudden short-lived request spikes cause expensive cold bursts or overly conservative autoscaling, increasing per-token unit economics for customers. This PR implements a lightweight burst-shaping batcher (Smooth Scaler) that absorbs micro-bursts within a tenant budget window and an \"onramp\" of conservative quantization profiles that can be applied dynamically during budgeted bursts. Goals: 1) keep 95th p95 latency SLOs stable for short bursts, 2) reduce token-cost churn by preferring small aggregation over expensive cold capacity, 3) provide a safe, observable path to enable lighter quantization only during budgeted bursts with automatic rollback on quality regressions. Changes are scoped to the serving runtime, config, and the tenant defaults registry plus a small Console telemetry surface for visualizing budget usage. This PR includes default tenant policy wiring, a simulator harness for synthetic burst replay, integration tests exercising fallback and rollback, and a docs snippet describing how operators can tune the burst budget and quant profiles. See linked linear tasks for simulation targets and SUP ticket for a customer incident that motivated conservative defaults.

review_conversation: Julian Park: Nice approach. Concern: how do we guarantee we don't increase p99 tail for long-running open sessions? Can we surface a hard fail-over to capacity?

Aisha Romero: Smooth Scaler only aggregates up to burst_budget_ms with a hard cutoff; beyond that we immediately fall back to allocation path that triggers normal autoscale. Added unit tests for cutoff behavior (see test_smooth_scaler.py).
Maya Singh: Telemetry looks good, but we need a quality gate before enabling q6_hybrid in production. Suggest a lightweight BLEU/likelihood check against tenant prompt set during the onramp.

Aisha Romero: Added a rollback hook that runs a prompt-set sample quality check; if regression > configured threshold we revert to previous profile and emit alert. Integration tests exercise rollback.
Diego Alvarez: Can we run the burst replay job in perf lab to check cost delta? Please attach run results before merge.

Aisha Romero: Attached synthetic replay figures in CI artifact and summarized in CI notes. Observed ~5-8% cost reduction for micro-bursty tenants with negligible median latency change; p99 unchanged in 90% of runs.

release_notes: Adds Smooth Scaler batcher to absorb tenant micro-bursts and conservative quantization onramp profiles that can be applied during budgeted bursts. Default configs are safe/off by default for older tenants; new tenants get conservative presets. Observability: tenant.burst_budget.* metrics and a Console read-only panel behind feature flag.
